thread:
aziz: Customer on Dedicated reporting repeated 429s and timeouts during a morning ramp. Customer says min_replicas=2, max_replicas=50 but traffic jump didn't get capacity fast enough. They saw ~120s of elevated queueing before any new pods became Ready.

olivia: thanks — can you paste a short repro and the customer request pattern?

aziz: Repro from customer: a scripted load hitting /v1/generate ~200 rps for 60s. They sent: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer <key>' -d '{"prompt":"x"}'` repeated. Errors show 429 then 503. Logs snippet from their side: `503 downstream_timeout` and our edge returned `429 rate_limit` around the same window.

raj: I pulled our autoscaler logs for that customer pool. I see probe failures and then an attach delay: `attach_queue_wait=95s`, then imagepull backoff on new nodes for ~40s in some cases. Autoscaler held off due to probe backoff policy (holdoff=30s, backoff_increment=2x).

sasha: interesting — attach_queue_wait often correlates with registry throttling or node provisioning delay. Any registry 429s in node events?

raj: yes a bunch of `ErrImagePull: rpc error: code = ResourceExhausted desc = registry rate limit` on 3 of 6 new nodes started. That slowed readiness. Also saw kubelet timeouts on warmpool attach steps: `warmpool attach timed out after 60s`.

aziz: customer also mentioned they recently rotated a service account for registry access. Could be bad creds or lower quota.

maria: infra-bot shows recent IAM key rotation for service-account:dedicated-pool-qa on Mar 19 04:02 UTC. That might explain transient registry auth failures.

infra-bot: [system] Incident note created: INC-2026-0345. Autoscaler holdoff + imagepull backoff + registry quota hit correlated with customer ramp window.

olivia: immediate mitigations we suggested: 1) Ask customer to increase reserved burst (temporary) or raise min_replicas to 4 for morning window. 2) Check registry creds/quotas and re-run a pre-warm image pull to populate node cache. 3) Add fallback route to use smaller model variant if attach delay exceeds 30s.

raj: for internal follow-up: eng-runtime to add a fast-fail path when attach_queue_wait > 30s so we can return graceful fallback earlier instead of queueing causing 429s. Also need to relax probe backoff for dedicated pools with warmpool enabled.

sasha: action items: - Confirm service-account rotation reverted or valid creds pushed to all nodes (infra) - Add a pre-pull job for common model images into warmpool nodes (eng-platform) - Short term: support to request customer's burst quota increase or bump min_replicas (support)

aziz: repro steps I logged for triage: 1) Create dedicated pool with min=2, warmpool enabled. 2) Deploy model image A. 3) Simulate registry auth failure (rotate creds) then ramp traffic to 200rps. 4) Observe attach_queue_wait and imagepull errors. Paste of autoscaler lines: ```[autoscaler] pool=d-4a2 attach_queue_wait=0s -> 95s holdoff=30s next_scale_attempt=2026-03-19T04:07:10Z backoff=60s```

raj: I can reproduce locally by throttling registry responses and simulating a warmpool attach. Will instrument more metrics: registry_auth_errors, imagepull_latency, attach_queue_size, attach_wait_s.

olivia: customer-facing note prepared: "We're investigating a transient warmpool attach delay combined with image registry quotas that slowed new pod readiness. Short-term workaround: bump min_replicas or reserved burst; we're also rolling a fallback policy to avoid queued requests becoming 429s." :thumbsup:

maria: assigning engineers: raj -> eng-runtime for autoscaler backoff tuning, sasha -> eng-platform for warmpool pre-pull, infra oncall -> check service-account rotation and registry quotas.

aziz: marking this P1 customer escalation. I've added logs and a minimal repro script to the incident. Will follow up with customer post-mitigation.

olivia: thanks team. If anyone finds a quick config that unblocks the customer, post it here and we'll push the change and notify INC-2026-0345. :white_check_mark:
